title: Content-Security-Policy style-src allows unsafe-hashes
description: The Content-Security-Policy style-src directive lists the `'unsafe-hashes'` keyword, which permits style attributes and inline style blocks whose text matches a hash listed in the policy. Any injected markup that reuses one of those trusted style bodies is applied even though the policy otherwise requires a nonce.
remediation: Remove `'unsafe-hashes'` from style-src and move the trusted declarations into a stylesheet the policy already allows. Replace attribute styles with classes.
limitation: One header value and one directive. The rule reports the keyword in style-src; it cannot tell whether any element in the document carries a style body that matches a listed hash.
